name: SubmittalRegisterManager
tagline: Know the latest date every submittal must go in – and which deliveries will miss site.
description: A complete construction submittal register for general contractors, construction managers and design teams: register by spec section, required-on-site dates back-scheduled from lead times into submit-by dates, review clocks, reviewer stamps (approved, approved as noted, revise and resubmit, rejected, for record), revisions with a revision limit, ball-in-court tracking, a procurement timeline, a rule-checked review board and reviewer turnaround scorecards. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Back-scheduled submit-by dates from ROS, lead time, review period and buffer
Forecast on-site date and ROS float with ROS-at-risk flags
Reviewer stamps with required comments for noted stamps
Revise-and-resubmit cycles with revisions and revision-limit escalation (OnAction)
Ball in court: subcontractor, design team, owner, contractor
Procurement timeline: float, submit-by, review, lead time, ROS
Rule-checked drag and drop review board
Reviewer turnaround, on-time returns and first-time approval
Bulk submit, close & distribute, assign reviewer, critical path; CSV export; undo
Demo mode with a fictional 40-submittal hospital project
controlType: standard (dataset control SubmittalRegisterManager + field control SubmittalRegisterManagerPortal, shared src/app)
